query:
UPDATE vacancies
         SET trust_flags = $2,
             flagged_at = CASE WHEN $2 = '[]'::jsonb THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(flagged_at, now()) END,
             trust_review = CASE WHEN trust_flags = $2 THEN trust_review END,
             trust_reviewed_at = CASE WHEN trust_flags = $2 THEN trust_reviewed_at END
         WHERE id = $1
